newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish jobless rate falls to 5.8 pct in Oct 96.
newsitem.headline: Turkish jobless rate falls to 5.8 pct in Oct 96.

text.p: Turkey's provisional unemployment rate fell to 5.8 percent in October 1996 from 6.3 percent in April 1996, the State Institute of Statistics said on Thursday.
The provisional urban unemployment rate was 9.3 percent and the rural unemployment rate was 2.9 percent in October 1996, compared to 10 and 3.9 percent, respectively a year ago.
Turkey's urban population made up 55 percent of the total in October 1996, the Institute said.
The number of unemployed was estimated at 1,332,000 in October 1996 and the number of employed at 21,698,000, 45.9 percent in agriculture, 32.3 percent in services and 21.8 percent in industry.
